page.layout: One printed page. Running head across the top, with page number at the right. Below it, a Hebrew and Latin subtitle line. Then a table of three parts: at left, civil dates; in the middle, day numbers beside the Thisri day names; at right, a column of notes in prose. Catchword "Mensis" at lower right.

main_text.head: תִּשְׁרִי Primus Mensis in anno Politico.
I. THISRI dierum 30.
main_text.p: Hic annus Iudaicus 5397. primus est in cyclo Lunari, quem praecessere cycli integri 284
Hic mensis est septimus in anno sacro.
De caede Godolię legendus Ierem. cap. 41.

page.notes: The Hebrew word תשרי is printed with vowel points; the Greek words are printed in Greek letters. The table cells are separated by " | " per the layout of the printed columns. The faint text in the background (show-through from the facing page) was left out.
